title: schizachyrium sanguineum subvar. semiberbe
intro: Schizachyrium sanguineum subvar. semiberbe, commonly known as Little Bluestem, is a species of grass native to North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating symptoms of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Schizachyrium sanguineum subvar. semiberbe include expectorant and anti-inflammatory effects, which can help to relieve coughs and soothe irritated tissues. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
